00082 /**
00083  * @brief               Show a file dialog and wait for user selection
00084  *
00085  * This function is called to create and show a file dialog. It is used
00086  * to display a "Save", "Save As", "Open" and "New" file dialog. 
00087  *
00088  * If pTitle is NULL, the title of the dialog is set to "Save", "Save As" or
00089  * "Open", based on the attributes.
00090  *
00091  * Note that if a file is selected, a new buffer will be allocated to store
00092  * the filename. The CALLER is responsible for free'ing this buffer.
00093  * 
00094  * @param pTitle         IN:    Title of the window; if NULL, display the
00095  *                              default title  
00096  * @param attributes     IN:    Attributes of the file dialog 
00097  * @param pFilenameIn    IN:    Initial filename, or NULL
00098  * @param hFilenameOut   OUT:   Pointer to var to receive address of newly 
00099  *                              malloc'ed buffer containing filename. If
00100  *                              file selection succeedes, the CALLER is 
00101  *                              responsible for free'ing this buffer. Set
00102  *                              to NULL if user cancels the file dialog.
00103  * @param pButton        OUT:   Index of the button that was pressed
00104  *
00105  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK on success, HX_MEMORY_ERROR
00106  *                              on memory allocation error. *hFilenameOut is 
00107  *                              set to NULL if there is an error.
00108  *
00109  **/
00110 HxResult HxFileDialog(const char* pTitle, HxFileDialogAttributes_t attributes, 
00111                       const char* pFilenameIn, char** hFilenameOut, 
00112                       HxFileDialogButtonType_t* pButton);
